¿Por qué la fecha de un evento puede ser: Why can an event’s date be different in my country?
Los eventos astronómicos ocurren en un i: Astronomical events happen at a specific instant in universal time (UTC). Depending on your time zone, that instant can fall on the previous or the next day. That is why the calendar times are converted to your zone automatically.
Es el nombre popular de las fechas con e: It is the popular name for dates with a repeated number, such as 11/11 or 12/12. It is a tradition of numerology and modern spirituality: they are considered symbolic moments to set intentions. It has no scientific basis.
